title: General properties of 3d transition metals
basic_overview: 3d metals show variable oxidation states, colour, magnetism, complex formation and catalytic activity because ns/(n−1)d energies are comparable.

extra_info_content.short_trick: Remove 4s before 3d for cations; then count d electrons.
extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Write neutral configuration. 2. Remove 4s first. 3. Count d electrons. 4. Use d count for magnetism/CFSE.
extra_info_content.factors: Sc³⁺ d⁰ and Zn²⁺ d¹⁰ are not transition ions under the usual definition.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
extra_info_content.exam_focus: Configuration, oxidation state and d-count questions.
